committedBefore: any probe of the 16 idle94 scenarios (calibration seen before: ONE Scene ON + ONE Scene OFF run of tools/battle-lab/mechanic-bulk-up-player-primeape-opponent-onix.json, which is the template of idle94-bulk-up-ply-a; production route b154 ON / OFF via idle94Route.ts)

anchors.F_att: first frame gBattlescriptCurrInstr == X, the move script's attackanimation byte (X = the pointer one frame before the waitanimation byte X+1 that is current on the activation frame)
anchors.A: activation: first frame gAnimScriptActive == 1 after F_att
anchors.F_after: first frame gBattlescriptCurrInstr == X+2 (waitanimation released; Scene OFF reaches it after BattleScript_Pausex20)
anchors.production: the move-animation command starts when the 'used X!' message command ends (route log: message start + its duration), i.e. production age 0 is displayed on the frame equivalent to ROM F_att; the next command starts at age D

formula: frames lost per body L = (F_after - F_att) - D = pre + N + trail + post, pre = A - F_att, post = F_after - E, trail = E - (A + N + D) (table.tsv)

general.leadRows: the ROM screen on A .. A+N-1 is byte-identical to the screen of A-1 (the idle field with the fully printed 'used X!' text; no glyph / sprite / palette / blend change is visible); register / OAM writes may happen without a visible change
general.leadReproducible: yes: the lead rows equal production's own age-0 frame only if window row 0 is still static; otherwise equal the idle field production already renders on the message command's last frame
general.OFF: Scene OFF F_after - F_att = 35 (attackanimation 1 + Pausex20 32 + return 1 + waitanimation 1) for every scenario
